preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) >= 2])
preconditions.description: Each test case has N nodes where N is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(p) == N-1 for N, p in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 parent nodes specified.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p_i) < i+1 for i, p_i in enumerate(line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each parent node p_i is a valid node number less than its child's index (1-based).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.
Each output line is a valid integer representing the maximum sum of subtree MEX-s.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout_line) <= N*(N-1) for N, stdout_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output integer for each test case is non-negative and does not exceed the theoretical maximum possible sum (N*(N-1)).

postconditions.expression: all(optimal_sum(N, parents) == int(stdout_line) for N, parents, stdout_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the maximum possible sum of subtree MEX-s for the given tree structure.
